# CompressPhoto (https://compressphoto.space)

> CompressPhoto is a 100% client-side, zero-upload biometric photo & signature compression studio. It locks JPEG, WebP, PNG, and ISO-32000 PDF files to exact kilobyte ceilings (10KB, 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB) at 300 DPI for government passport, visa, and civil service exam portals. All processing runs inside browser RAM (GDPR compliant, open-source auditable).

- Full AI Specification Documentation: [https://compressphoto.space/llms-full.txt](https://compressphoto.space/llms-full.txt)
- Open-Source Repository: [https://github.com/abdelkhalekkaci/exactkb](https://github.com/abdelkhalekkaci/exactkb)
